description: CPUOffloadingSpec sizes its tier from cpu_bytes_to_use, the worker bytes a block, the world size and blocks_per_chunk, each chunk rounded up to the alignment. From v0.33.0 config_info reports the sizing (vllm/v1/kv_offload/cpu/common.py:34-72@4ba787ec); with max_model_len unknown its tokens read "None".
